_comment: Filing-mapping ratchet baseline (scripts/filing_mapping_report.py --check). placed_cells may not DECREASE; unplaced_figures, structure_findings and error_rule_breaks, and every cell of their breakdowns (unplaced_by_reason, structure_by_table, error_rules_by_rule), may not INCREASE. Re-measure with --update-baseline after a deliberate change and say why in _note; never type the numbers.
_note: First bank (rwa-filer Phase 2), extended in Phase 3 with structure_findings. placed/unplaced are unchanged from the first bank: 1911 distinct cells land on a PRA001 v4.1.1 data point; 1025 distinct non-zero figures do not, 816 of them because our IRB sheets (OF 08.01-08.05) are per exposure class while the published sheet axis also splits by approach and SME / non-SME. structure_findings is new: 8 placed facts cannot be filed as generated. STR007 OF02.00.01.01 - rows 0050 and 0060 (and OF 07.00 total sheet c0220) are one data point in the taxonomy and hold different values. STR007 OF08.01.01.01 - c0276 (output-floor RWEA) disagrees with the OF 02.00 c0020 cell that is the same data point. STR007 OF02.01.01.03 - r0080 c0030 (U-TREA) disagrees with OF 02.00 r0010 c0010. STR006 OF08.03.01.01 - c0080 is an integer metric and we report a fractional maturity. The adapter now writes the yes/no cell OF 02.00 r0034 c0030 as true/false, which removed the STR006 it produced in all 13 portfolios before this bank. 2026-11-13: error_rule_breaks added - the Error-severity rules of the v4.1.1 rule book that the placed return breaks, as (rule, portfolio) pairs: 128 pairs over 33 rules. Banked as found, to hold the list while it is worked down. Not all 33 are defects in the estate: boe_b0710 (OF 07.00 c0150 against the off-balance-sheet conversion-factor breakdown, on rows that include the on-balance-sheet total) cannot hold for a return that follows Annex II's own definition of columns 0160-0190, and boe_b0778 / boe_b0779 contradict each other on OF 08.07 c0050; tests/expected_outputs/reporting/validation_known_breaks.json records the analysis of each. 2026-11-13 (second bank): OF 09.02 RWEA moved from column 0125 to its published column 0110. placed_cells 1911 -> 1935 and unplaced_figures 1025 -> 1001 (the 24 c09_02 column_not_in_taxonomy figures now have a cell). error_rule_breaks 128 -> 132, read rule by rule: boe_b0278 and boe_b0296 (OF 09.02 RWEA against the OF 08.01 institutions and QRRE sheets) now HOLD; boe_b0284, boe_b0293, boe_b0302, boe_b1055 and boe_b1060 now break. Those five are the RWEA members of the 'OF 09.02 country total = OF 08.01 sheet' family whose exposure members (boe_b0282, b0283, b0291, b0292, b0301, b1053, b1054, b1058, b1059) were already breaking for the same reason - the OF 08.01 corporate and retail sheets are not placed (sheet_coarser_than_published_axis). They were not evaluated before only because the OF 09.02 side was empty too. Owner: the OF 08 sheet split. 2026-11-13 (third bank): OF 08.07 no longer reports its three share columns (0030, 0040, 0050) as 0.0 on a row with no exposure - each is a quotient over the row's column 0020 (PS1/26 Annex II 3.3.10.2) and is now left empty. error_rule_breaks 132 -> 119 over 34 rules: boe_b0778 (c0030 + c0040 + c0050 = 1) broke on all thirteen portfolios and now breaks on none. No other rule's count moved; placed_cells, unplaced_figures and structure_findings are unchanged (a 0.0 share was never a placed figure). boe_b0779 still breaks on four portfolios and is not this defect - validation_known_breaks.json records why. 2026-11-13 (fourth bank): OF 07.00 no longer reports a figure in a cell the published template greys out. unplaced_figures 1001 -> 954; c07_00|cell_not_reportable 52 -> 5 distinct cells. The five that remain are memorandum row 0320 on the 'in default' sheet: Annex II 3.2.2 para 55 asks for it there and the taxonomy publishes rows 0300/0320 on sheets 0001-0004 and 0007-0009 only - the open question recorded as P1.377, not a grey cell. placed_cells, structure_findings and error_rule_breaks did not move. 2026-11-13 (fifth bank): C 07.00 / OF 07.00 gained its Total sheet (sheet code 0001). placed_cells 1935 -> 2334. error_rule_breaks 119 -> 109, read rule by rule: boe_b0713 (sheet 0001 equals the sum of the class sheets) broke on eleven portfolios and now breaks on none; boe_b0710_1 newly breaks on one (rich) - the boe_b0710 question, on memorandum row 0320 of the Total, reachable only now that a published sheet carries that row; validation_known_breaks.json records both sides of it. No other rule moved. ONE METRIC ROSE AND IS BANKED DELIBERATELY: structure_findings 8 -> 9, STR007 on OF07.00.01.01 0 -> 1 (portfolios ccr, crm-substitution, facility-share-binding, facility-share-nonbinding, irb-classes, rich). The taxonomy makes the Total sheet's RWEA (r0010 c0220) one data point with OF 02.00 r0050 c0010 and r0060 c0010 (data point 7846). The Total's figure is the SA RWEA and agrees with our r0060; it conflicts with our r0050, which carries the CREDIT TOTAL because the C 02.00 / OF 02.00 row codes are offset from the published ones (published r0050 is the Standardised Approach). So the finding is that defect showing on one more cell, and it goes when OF 02.00 is re-keyed - the same owner as the existing STR007 on OF02.00.01.01. unplaced_figures did not move. 2026-11-13 (sixth bank): equity and CIU holdings now carry their counterparty's country (engine/hierarchy/enrich.py::attach_obligor_country_to_equity), so they report on their country sheet of OF 09.01 and not only on the all-countries one. placed_cells 2334 -> 2350; error_rule_breaks 109 -> 107: boe_b0904 (the country sheets add up to the all-countries sheet) broke on two portfolios and now breaks on none. No other rule and no other metric moved. 2026-11-13 (seventh bank): three changes, measured together. (1) C 02.00 / OF 02.00 took the published row codes and cells (corep/c02_rows.py, held to the taxonomy by tests/contracts/test_of02_published_cells.py): the credit-risk total moved from row 0050 to 0040, the approach totals from 0220 / 0240 / 0300 to 0240 / 0250 / 0310, column 0010 became the un-floored RWEA, column 0020 is reported on the modelled rows only and column 0030 on rows 0010 and 0034-0036 only. (2) The measurement now passes the run's own floor summary, as export_filing_package does, so the return measured is the return filed - OF-ADJ is not on the ledger and without the summary the floor cannot be stated. (3) Two defects in how a data point shown in several cells was handled: the adapter now files one value where the cells agree to rounding (filing/canonical.py), and the rule engine reads a fact in every reported table that shows its data point (rwa_filer/boe/engine.py), as the gateway and the engine's own read-back path always did. unplaced_figures 954 -> 901 (all 53 c_02_00 figures now have a cell). structure_findings 9 -> 1: every STR007 is gone and only STR006 on OF08.03 c0080 remains (average maturity in years against an integer-typed data point - a reading for the firm to make). error_rule_breaks 107 -> 52: boe_b0359, boe_b0716 and boe_b1093 13 -> 0 each, boe_b0793 13 -> 5, boe_b0621 / b0625 / b0638 / b0643 / b0649 / b0652 / b1060 -> 0, boe_b0284 and boe_b0293 2 -> 1. ONE METRIC FELL AND IS BANKED DELIBERATELY: placed_cells 2350 -> 2349. The cell lost is OF02.00 r0500 c0010, where the Art. 123B currency-mismatch memorandum figure was being filed; published row 0500 is settlement/delivery risk in the non-trading book, so the figure was in another figure's cell (it still reports at OF 07.00 row 0380). TWO RULES ROSE AND ARE BANKED DELIBERATELY: boe_b0738 and boe_b0751 0 -> 2 (irb-classes, crm-substitution). Both read OF 08.01's Total A-IRB sheet (0001). That sheet's RWEA is one data point with OF 02.00 r0310, which now holds the A-IRB total, so the gateway sees one cell of a sheet we do not otherwise produce: 80,755.66 against a sheet with no column 0251-0254 and no OF 08.03 beside it. Before, row 0310 was a mis-keyed zero and the sheet looked empty. Owner: the OF 08 sheet split. boe_b0793 still breaks on the five portfolios whose OF-ADJ is not zero: the rule computes x * (S-TREA + OF-ADJ) where Art. 92(2A) and Annex II 1.3.1 both say x * S-TREA + OF-ADJ, and we report the latter. 2026-11-13 (eighth bank): Basel 3.1 OF 07.00 reports on-balance-sheet netting once - the adjusted value of the netted deposit in col 0035 and only genuine financial collateral in col 0130 - and the matrix gains netting-mismatch (13 -> 14 Basel 3.1 runs). boe_b0471 1 -> 0 (the double deduction, escape log 2026-09-05). boe_b0710 11 -> 12: the new portfolio is one more return the open boe_b0710 question applies to (col 0150 against the conversion-factor breakdown on rows with on-balance-sheet exposure), not a new break. error_rule_breaks stays 52; placed_cells, unplaced_figures and structure_findings did not move. 2026-11-13 (ninth bank): Basel 3.1 OF 08.01 / 08.02 / 08.03 / 08.05 are generated on the published 17-sheet axis (reporting/corep/irb_sheets.py, held to the taxonomy by tests/contracts/test_of08_published_sheets.py) with their two Total sheets. placed_cells 2349 -> 4106; unplaced_figures 901 -> 523 - every sheet_coarser_than_published_axis figure (816) now has a sheet. MOVED THE PERMISSIVE WAY AND BANKED DELIBERATELY, each a figure that had no place before and now shows what was wrong with it: (1) structure_findings 1 -> 47. STR006 on OF08.01 c0250 and OF08.03 c0080: exposure-weighted maturity reported as a fraction (days, years) against data points the taxonomy types integer - the open question of how to round it, for the firm. STR007 on OF02.00 r0297 / OF08.01 z0012 c0260 on facility-share-binding: OF 02.00 is un-floored, OF 08.01 sums rwa_final with the engine's floor add-on - P1.369. (2) Unplaced-reason cells: c08_02|open_rows_not_mapped 40 -> 418 and c08_04|sheet_has_no_published_code 0 -> 6 are reclassifications - the same figures were counted under sheet_coarser, the first reason that applied; OF 08.02's open rows are still not keyed, and C 08.04 is a single-sheet table in PRA001 that we generate per class. c08_01|cell_not_reportable 4 -> 60: OF 08.01 greys some cells per sheet (retail c0250 among them) and we still fill them - the OF 08.01 analogue of the OF 07.00 grey-cell work. (3) error_rule_breaks 52 -> 63 - newly evaluated rules that fail on placed figures: boe_b0735-b0739 (the Bank's OF 08.03 rules include the FIRB-and-slotting sheets; Annex II para 77 excludes slotting from OF 08.03, and the gap is exactly OF 08.01 row 0080); boe_b0741 / b0742 (OF 08.01 rows 0031-0035 empty while row 0030 carries the total); boe_b0748 (c0250 on sheets Annex II excludes); boe_b1034, b1051-b1055 (OF 09.02 classifies financial and large corporates from cp_apply_fi_scalar, OF 02.00 / OF 08 from exposure_subclass; and OF 02.00 zero-fills class rows, which reports the shared OF 08.01 sheet as 0); boe_b0283 / b0284 (the crm-substitution retail-guarantor leg, downstream of the missing Art. 201 eligibility gate); boe_b0621 / b0751 (P1.369). Fixed at the same time: boe_b0282, b0631, b0749, b1041, b1058, b1059 -> 0 portfolios.
